audit.why: 49.88% over 433 games — a genuine coin flip, and the page already sells it as a pre-6 race Pantheon must win. Level 6 is the hinge.
Spikes sit in the right places: your levels 2-3, his level 6, his first AP item. Only the reasons attached to them were wrong, not the timings.

audit.whatIsWrong: Kennen's Q is called 'Lightning Surge' and described as a slow bolt; Slicing Maelstrom is called a channelled chain-stun; and his poke is called 'energy-free'.
audit.why: Three separate errors against Riot's own text. His Q is Thundering Shuriken, and Riot describes it as 'a fast moving shuriken' — the opposite of a slow bolt, which changes whether you can sidestep it. Lightning Surge is not an ability in his kit at all; Lightning Rush is his E. Slicing Maelstrom is 'summons a storm that strikes at nearby enemies' — a persistent aura he walks around with, not a channel, so there is nothing to interrupt and standing in it is what stuns you. And every one of his abilities costs energy; Thundering Shuriken is 7/6.25/5.5/4.75/4s and Electrical Surge 13/11.25/9.5/7.75/6s, so his poke is cooldown- and energy-limited, not free.
audit.corrected: Thundering Shuriken named and described as fast, Lightning Surge deleted, Slicing Maelstrom restated as a 120s aura that stacks Mark of the Storm, and the energy claim corrected.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing about how the stun is actually built, and nothing about Electrical Surge applying on-hit.
audit.why: Mark of the Storm stuns at three stacks, and Electrical Surge passively adds a mark every few attacks as well as on cast. That means his stun is an attack-speed problem, not a spell problem — armour reads the trade wrong. It also means the real interaction with your kit is one-way: his stun cancels Aegis Assault mid-channel, and Aegis Assault only blocks damage from the front, so it never stops the mark that stuns you.
audit.corrected: Electrical Surge and the three-mark stun written into mid and late, with the Aegis Assault limitation stated.

audit.why: Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120s at every rank — that is the largest punishable window in the lane and the page treated his ult as permanently available. Lightning Rush is 10/9/8/7/6s and is his only disengage.
audit.corrected: 120s and the Lightning Rush window written into mid.

edits.before: His Slicing Maelstrom (R) is the lane flip: a chain-stun AoE that locks you for a full combo and lets him kite your Aegis Assault.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom is the lane flip — a 120s storm that keeps adding Mark of the Storm, and every third mark stuns you out of Aegis Assault.

edits.before: His Lightning Surge (Q) is a slow bolt and he has no stun pre-6, but your level 1 is also setup — deny his last hits and you both jockey for the first window.
edits.after: Thundering Shuriken is fast, but it is one mark and he needs three to stun anything — deny his last hits and you both jockey for the first window.

edits.before: Slicing Maelstrom (R) chain-stuns you through your Aegis Assault and lets him reset distance — his ult outvalues your level-6 bump.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom stacks Mark of the Storm until you are stunned out of Aegis Assault — his 120s ult outvalues your level-6 bump.

edits.before: Kite back with move-speed passive and energy-free Q/W poke, never letting you reach W range
edits.after: Kite back with Lightning Rush speed and Thundering Shuriken, never letting you reach 600

edits.before: Stack Mark of the Storm to trigger the third-proc stun on his terms
edits.after: Stack Mark of the Storm with Electrical Surge autos and stun on his terms

edits.before: Level 1 is yours — his Lightning Surge (Q) is a slow bolt and he has no stun yet, so step up and punish him whenever he goes for a creep. At 2 and 3 your W-stun into Q-tap is a real kill threat; W in, stun, empowered-Q, and back out before his energy poke matters. The thing to respect is Mark of the Storm — don't sit in his Q+W double-mark range or you eat a free stun, and angle your Aegis Assault (E) toward his Q to block the poke while you walk him down.
edits.after: Level 1 is yours — Thundering Shuriken (Q) is fast but it is only one Mark of the Storm, and he needs three to stun anything, so step up and punish him whenever he goes for a creep. At 2 and 3 your Shield Vault into empowered Comet Spear is a real kill threat; stun, burst, and leave. What to respect is the mark count, not the damage: Thundering Shuriken plus Electrical Surge is two marks, and his next auto is the third. Face Aegis Assault (E) at his shuriken while you walk him down.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are still playable — your E blocks his single-skillshot poke and your held Q out-ranges his comfort zone if he plays forward. But level 6 flips it: Slicing Maelstrom (R) is a channeled chain-stun that locks you down through your E channel and lets him kite your W cooldown. Don't all-in into his available ult. Get your trades and your kills in BEFORE he hits 6, and if he ults you, E away from the stun ticks rather than toward him.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are still playable — Aegis Assault blocks Thundering Shuriken and your held Comet Spear outranges him if he plays forward. Level 6 flips it, but not the way it reads: Slicing Maelstrom is not a channel, it is a 120s storm he walks around inside, and it keeps applying Mark of the Storm until the third one stuns you. That stun cancels Aegis Assault, which only blocked damage from the front anyway. Kill him before 6; once it is spent you have two minutes.

edits.before: You fall off hard here and he comes online — a full-AP Kennen with Rocketbelt or Liandry's kites your W gap, re-stuns with R, and his Mark detonations chunk your squishy frame through your shields. Don't try to solo him; it's a losing duel once he has items and ult up. Convert any early lead with Grand Starfall (R) roams and side-lane pressure, and let your team soak his teamfight ult instead of facechecking him 1v1.
edits.after: You fall off hard and he comes online — Rocketbelt or Liandry's Kennen kites Shield Vault's 600 and re-stuns through Slicing Maelstrom. Note what actually kills you: Electrical Surge applies on-hit and marks every few attacks, so his damage and his stun both scale with attack speed, and flat armour reads that trade wrong. Don't solo him once his ult is up. Convert the early lead with Grand Starfall roams and side pressure, and let your team soak the ult.

notes: Both packet suspectNames were real. 'Lightning Surge' is not an ability Kennen has — his Q is Thundering Shuriken and Lightning Rush is his E — and the page also called that Q 'a slow bolt' when Riot's text says 'a fast moving shuriken', which inverts whether you can sidestep it. Second real error: Slicing Maelstrom was described as a channelled chain-stun that 'locks you down through your E channel'. Riot's text is 'summons a storm that strikes at nearby enemies' — a persistent aura Kennen moves with. There is no channel to interrupt, and what stuns you is the third Mark of the Storm, not the ult itself. Third: his poke was called 'energy-free'; every Kennen ability costs energy and both poke tools are on real cooldowns (Q 7s down to 4s, W 13s down to 6s). Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120s at all three ranks, which is the biggest punishable window in the lane and the page never mentioned it.
